name: Moon Knight

abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Bleed: Zamanla doğrudan fiziksel kanama hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Evade: Rakip saldırılarından otomatik olarak kaçmayı sağlar.

signatureAbility:
Synodic Tide
Either Combat Power Rate is enhanced by up to [10 - 33]%, or enemies suffer [10 - 33]% reduced Combat Power Rate. This cycles every 6 hours.

abilitySections.title: Passive
content: Withheld from Death herself by the Egyptian Moon-god Khonshu, Marc Spector's power ebbs and flows based on the phase of the Moon.

abilitySections.title: All Attacks
content: As the Moon waxes, boost Critical Rating by [1,108.21] for 3 seconds with up to a 8% chance. The chance increases nearer to the Full Moon.
As the Moon wanes, gain [1,767.15] Fury for 5 seconds with up to a 10% chance. The chance increases nearer to the New Moon.

abilitySections.title: Critical Hits
content: Under the light of the Full Moon, Critical Hits have a 15% chance to Stun for 3 seconds.
Critical Hits lacerate opponents with a 70% chance, inflicting [2,159.85] Bleed damage over 3 seconds.

abilitySections.title: When Attacked
content: In the darkness of a New Moon, evade attacks with a 5% chance.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: This attack receives [562.5] additional Critical Rating.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: Any Bleed effects triggered by this attack have 50% increased duration.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Synodic Tide
content: Either Combat Power Rate is enhanced by up to [10 - 33]%, or enemies suffer [10 - 33]% reduced Combat Power Rate. This cycles every 6 hours.
